# Regulated-industry deployment guides

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-industry-guides.mts. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate: npm run gen-industry-guides. Drift check: npm run check:industry-guides -->

**Status:** experimental. AI-drafted; not reviewed by a qualified expert; not legal advice.

**Claim:** Self-reported · **Result:** not evaluated (no applicability decision is recorded) · **Evidence:** incomplete · **Enforcement:** none · **Review:** pending · **Applicability:** unresolved

One guide per AMC station. Each maps the station's sector packs to the frameworks they name, the assurance packs linked to the station, the deployment controls and the evidence outputs. These guides are not legal advice and do not state what any regulation requires.

## Stations

Stations are the keys of `DOMAIN_REGISTRY` [C1]; packs are grouped by `stationId` [C2].

## How these guides stay true

- `scripts/gen-industry-guides.mts` generates every guide from source. `npm run check:industry-guides` (run in CI) fails when a committed guide differs from a fresh render; regenerate with `npm run gen-industry-guides`.
- `tests/industryGuides.test.ts` re-derives every pack, question and scenario count from source, and fails when an appendix row no longer lands on a line containing its token, printing where the token is now.
- [The regulatory calendar](../REGULATORY_CALENDAR.md) is generated from `GLOBAL_FRAMEWORKS` [C3] and the sourced register's key dates [C4] by `node scripts/gen-regulatory-calendar.mjs`; `npm run check:regulatory-calendar` fails when the page and its sources disagree.

## Shared caveats

- Pack questions and these guides are AI-drafted and experimental: no qualified expert has reviewed them, and nothing in them is evaluated until an operator answers a pack.
- Deployment controls and evidence outputs do not vary by station in source; each guide repeats them so it stands alone.
- `amc domain assurance` invokes no agent and reports every pack not evaluated [C5]; use `amc assurance run --agent <id> --pack <packId>` to grade the agent [C6].
